verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents public Cloud APIs that can be called over REST or through client libraries to automate workflows. It also publishes REST reference documentation, for example for programmatic billing management, and gcloud is documented as the interface to those APIs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use, and evidence of API reference depth beyond the Billing API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Google Cloud APIs allow you to automate your workflows by using your favorite language. Use these Cloud APIs with REST calls or client libraries in popular programming languages.
Allows developers to manage billing for their Google Cloud Platform projects programmatically.
The `gcloud` CLI manages authentication, local configuration, developer workflow, and interactions with the Google Cloud APIs.
